rationale: The agent properly verified identity using full name and zip, accessed only the authenticated user’s data, and accurately read order and product details. Address correction for order #W9583042 was executed correctly, and the jigsaw item in order #W4082615 was changed to an appropriate “easiest” available variant, with an accurate refund noted to PayPal. However, the policy requires that before any order-changing write, the agent must state the exact change and obtain explicit confirmation to proceed. The agent executed both the address update and the jigsaw item change without first restating the exact change and asking for explicit confirmation. While the user did request the changes, the missing confirm-before-write step violates the stated pass bar. All other actions and information appear correct and supported by tools.
